scripts.test: for dir in packages/*; do (cd $dir && [ -f package.json ] && bun run test 2>/dev/null || true); done
scripts.compile: for dir in packages/*; do (cd $dir && [ -f package.json ] && bun run compile 2>/dev/null || true); done
scripts.watch: for dir in packages/*; do (cd $dir && [ -f package.json ] && bun run watch 2>/dev/null &); done; wait
